zh: 每一类的价格严格递增，所以在任何一类里都应该从第一件开始连续购买。
问题等价于把 n 个递增序列合并后取前 m 小的和；每一类只需要关心它“下一件”的价格。
用最小堆保存每类的（下一件价格, 公差）；重复 m 次：弹出最小价格加到答案，再把价格加上公差放回堆。价格和总额都要用 64 位。
en: Prices within a category strictly increase, so within any category you should buy a prefix starting from the first item.
The task is the sum of the m smallest values of n merged increasing sequences; each category only matters through the price of its next item.
Keep a min-heap of (next price, step) per category; m times, pop the minimum, add its price to the answer, and push it back with the step added. Prices and the total need 64 bits.

explanationEn:
## Approach

A min-heap keeps the cheapest unbought item of each category; each time, pop the minimum price, add it, and push the next price of the same category; do this m times.

## Proof of correctness

A positive b guarantees that the prices of each category strictly increase, so any plan that buys a later item while skipping a cheaper earlier one can be improved. The minimum over the category fronts is the minimum over all unbought items, so repeatedly taking it yields exactly the m smallest items of the merged increasing sequences, and no other m items can have a smaller sum.

## Complexity

O(n+m log n) time and O(n) space; costs use 64 bits.
